facts.fact: The article (Magolego, Financial Regulation Journal, 2026-02-18) states that the National Credit Act affordability assessment, sections 81 and 82 read with Regulation 23A, is a conduct and consumer protection requirement applying to credit providers including digital lenders, with debt review and reckless lending findings as remedies.

systems.system: National Credit Act affordability assessment (ss 81-82, Regulation 23A)
